prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, high fidelity TraceLoft Sim screen concept, landscape 4:3 aspect matching 13 inch iPad Pro 1366x1024 CSS resolution, flat front view of app UI only, no device frame. All content within viewport, generous but efficient spacing, accurate legible typography. Existing approved Vector design: pure WHITE background and panels, very thin pale gray straight dividers, near-black/navy text, restrained vivid cobalt #2459ef selections. Square rectangular panels/buttons, NO rounded cards, NO shadows, no gradients. Only club selectors circular. Modern clean sans serif.
Header top: TraceLoft wordmark (Trace navy, Loft cobalt), navigation 'Relay  Practice  Sim  Play  Analyze  Sessions', underline Sim in cobalt. Right compact green dot 'Recording' and 'GSPro connected'. This is a proposed page, small 'DESIGN CONCEPT' label in top header.
Title row: large 'Sim', supporting 'Club selection & shot tracking'; right 'Leave page' quiet button and 'End session' outlined square button. No duplicated recording bar. No hole score, map, graphs or drill targets.
Next section 'NEXT SHOT' and 'My bag / 7 iron' strong selected label. Compact left bag rail 175px wide with three stacked wide squared tabs 'My bag' selected in pale cobalt, 'Travel bag', '+ Add bag', small 'Manage bags' link below, clear vertical divider. To right exactly FOURTEEN large circular club buttons in two rows of seven, 68px diameter minimum with spacious gaps: first row 'Dr', '3W', '5W', '4i', '5i', '6i', '7i'; second row '8i', '9i', 'PW', 'GW', 'SW', 'LW', 'PT'. 7i is saturated cobalt filled circle white label with check indicator. All other circles thin gray outlines dark labels. Comfortable large touch controls.
Below full-width latest shot section label 'LAST SHOT #12  ·  My bag / 7 iron' on left, tiny 'Source-reported' on right. Six generous equal rectangular metric cells across, large bold numbers (about 44px) and clear units: Carry '154' 'yd', Total '162' 'yd', Offline '8 R' 'yd', Ball speed '112' 'mph', Spin '6,420' 'rpm', Launch '18.4°'. White tiles divided by fine rules, cobalt only Carry number.
Below: 'Where did shot #12 finish?' left, 'Optional · manual outcome' muted right. One row of seven large squared tap buttons labeled 'Fairway', 'Rough', 'Bunker', 'Green', 'Water', 'OB', 'Other'. Rough selected outlined cobalt with small check. Separate small inline text underneath 'Saved: Rough' and link 'Undo', and on right 'Penalty / note…' action. Critical visual semantic: this row attaches to LAST shot #12, separate from NEXT shot club choice.
Bottom full-width 'Shot log' title, tools 'All clubs' and 'Export CSV'. A detailed readable table fitting width with headings '#', 'Bag / club', 'Carry', 'Total', 'Offline', 'Ball speed', 'Spin', 'Launch', 'Descent', 'Outcome', 'Penalty', 'Edit'. Three coherent rows newest first: 12 / My bag · 7 iron / 154 yd / 162 yd / 8 R yd / 112 mph / 6,420 rpm / 18.4° / 46.2° / Rough / — / edit icon; 11 / My bag · 7 iron / 158 yd / 166 yd / 2 L yd / 114 mph / 6,280 rpm / 18.1° / 45.8° / Fairway / — / edit icon; 10 / My bag · 6 iron / 172 yd / 181 yd / 14 R yd / 120 mph / 5,710 rpm / 16.8° / 43.5° / Bunker / — / edit icon. Small bottom note 'Outcome tags are manual. Shot measurements stay unchanged.' All data synthetic design examples. Avoid extra panels, legends, decorative golf photos or sim score claims. Prioritize glanceable metrics and large buttons over table density.
